problem.problem:
Bob is quiet. Bob is smart. Charlie is kind. Charlie is smart. Charlie is white. Erin is blue. Harry is green. White, green things are smart. Smart, quiet things are white. All quiet, kind things are white. If Erin is kind and Erin is blue then Erin is white. All kind things are quiet. White things are quiet. Green things are kind. All white, smart things are furry.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Bob is white.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?

Facts:
Quiet(Bob, True) ::: Bob is quiet.
Smart(Bob, True) ::: Bob is smart.
Kind(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is kind.
Smart(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is smart.
White(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is white.
Blue(Erin, True) ::: Erin is blue.
Green(Harry, True) ::: Harry is green.

Rules:
White($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: White, green things are smart.
Smart($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: Smart, quiet things are white.
Quiet($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: All quiet, kind things are white.
Kind(Erin, True) && Blue(Erin, True) >>> White(Erin, True) ::: If Erin is kind and Erin is blue then Erin is white.
Kind($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: All kind things are quiet.
White($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: White things are quiet.
Green($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: Green things are kind.
White($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: All white, smart things are furry.

Query:
White(Bob, True) ::: Bob is white.
